scope: Proposal reuse decision, inspected primary sources, exact explanatory constructions and integrated manuscript
steps: Bind the exact R commit, local technical files, source license, dependency declarations and maintenance evidence.
Resolve Google R, google/tfp-causalimpact and aGrUM name collisions. Treat the Python engine as a separate candidate, with no automatic equivalence.
Inspect input clocks, response masking, posterior and cumulative summaries, failure outputs and upstream test intent. Record the actual local runtime inventory.
Reproduce finite control-contamination, dependence, relative-effect and stock/flow examples using exact arithmetic; do not describe these as fitted CausalImpact results.
Choose a scoped disposition, define proposed conversion/failure and future behavioral-oracle contracts, alternatives, cost categories, owners and revisit triggers.
Integrate a preserving manuscript successor; inspect source claims and extracted text, compile, audit every citation and renew exact-reader Q2–Q4 reviews.
Record the reviewed reuse disposition and continue the next eligible independent operation.
review_findings: The exact local R4.1.2 environment does not meet the pinned R>=4.5.0 dependency. No old-version substitution or environment upgrade is necessary to finish a proposal reference decision.
A dependency DESCRIPTION is a declared constraint, not a solved environment. bsts, Boom and BoomSpikeSlab license terms must be recorded separately from CausalImpact Apache2.0.
Good pre-period fit cannot rule out post-treatment control contamination or an untreated structural break; examples must expose this ambiguity.
Posterior quantiles, cumulative path dependence, relative ratios, finite simulation tail areas and stock/flow units cannot be collapsed into a generic confidence interval.
A justified reference decision closes this operation without granting integration_allowed, runtime qualification or bank acceptance.
Q5 rendered acceptance remains open under the inherited six-image limit; text and source work continues.
